exact_quantifier_mode: universal/asymptotic reductions, not a finite sweep

C1.quantified_scope: all d>=1, M>0, delta>0 and all supported mixing laws
C1.premise_ledger: Hermite expansion, C-D kernel bound, restricted-range/Nikolskii inequalities, and Lambert lemma are reconstructed in the pinned paper and explicitly anchored here

C2.quantified_scope: all positive density pairs; C1 supplies the Gaussian-mixture specialization

C3.monotone_subsequence_rule: if a_n>0 and a_n->0, recursively choose k_(j+1)>k_j with a_k<min(a_kj,1/(j+1)); then a_kj decreases to zero and every eventual inequality is retained
C3.quantified_scope: existence of an infinite sequence; not inferred from the six numerical orders
C3.premise_ledger: Chebyshev moment construction and its uniform tail bounds from Lemma 3.2

C4.quantified_scope: every Hellinger-compact subclass, conditional on the exact Jia local-entropy premise
C4.premise_ledger: Jia et al. Corollary 11, separately pinned and source-audited

C5_upper.quantified_scope: all sufficiently large n and every Huber contaminant Q
C5_upper.premise_ledger: TV entropy lemma and the proper Yatracos deterministic inequality

C5_lower.two_point_risk: identical observation laws and the metric triangle inequality imply max risk>=H(P1,P2)^2/4
C5_lower.quantified_scope: every sufficiently small epsilon and every fixed dimension via a common Gaussian product factor
C5_lower.premise_ledger: Lemma 3.2 uniform tail bounds and Chen-Gao-Ren equal-law lemma
